payload.core_composition_summary: Uses bit manipulation to get initial power-of-two decomposition, then greedy splitting (exchange argument) to meet exactly k terms with minimal max exponent.
payload.rationale: The solution first extracts set bits from n's binary form, then greedily splits larger powers into smaller ones to increase the count to k, ensuring the minimal maximum exponent.
